notes.title: Revealing Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy for 2026 🎉
notes.content: [h2]Greetings everyone,[/h2][p][/p][p]Our hearts are pounding at the idea that this is happening. We're so excited to announce and finally reveal [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] to the public. 🎉🎉🥹  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy?utm_campaign=RAPTL_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=Steam#wishlist"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Embark on an original story, prequel to the first two [i]A Plague Tale[/i] games. As Sophia, journey to the Minotaur’s Island, outsmart deadly foes, unravel ancient secrets, and confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse.   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Watch the Reveal Trailer now, don't miss a bit of it![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="lroYak-ryyM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]🗡️ What will [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] be like?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p] [b]STRONG, FIERCE AND LETHAL[/b] [/p][p]Sophia is a skilled, agile, and strong-willed fighter who engages in dynamic and violent melee combat. Followed by many enemies, each drawn to the Island to reclaim a mysterious treasure, you must navigate a treacherous maze. Rely on your agility, tricks and sharp reflexes to outsmart enemies, perfect your parries, and unleash powerful strikes to survive deadly encounters.   [/p][p][/p][p][b]BOUNDED BY LEGACY[/b] [/p][p]Shift between the Middle Age of Sophia and ancient Minoan times, where echoes of the past shape the battles of the present. Unfold a new story in the universe of [i]A Plague Tale[/i], through the entwined destinies of two heroes linked by fate and the Macula’s mysterious legacy. [/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/0e4d4baed6c03887da127b0978140bf57c57e663.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/dd8c90a17039e485b31be36b470b05347f654e88.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][b]A MYTHICAL ISLAND[/b] [/p][p]Guided by the knowledge safeguarded in your notebook, follow in your crew’s footsteps to explore a richly detailed world, unravel its secrets, and face deadly trials. Use a stolen Minoan sphere to solve ingenious puzzles by manipulating light - a force woven by Daedalus into the island’s very heart.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IN THE MIST OF SHADOWS[/b] [/p][p]It is said that only a few came back from the island. Lurking in the shadows lives a restless presence. It follows you around, seemingly knowing your every move, as it hunts through the island’s depths.   Every step is a risk. Every pause, a potential end. You can’t stop, only hide, outsmart, and push forward. Can you survive each trial and every step or will you join those who never came back? [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/ffbb749b71608a957ce384cd62df4f748d87411b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/4db6aa408dcfbe11cd6ad6e2cb64b4303100d485.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3][b]Wishlist it now!🌟[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Click here to already put [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] in your wishlist on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy?utm_campaign=RAPTL_Reveal&utm_medium=post&utm_source=Steam#wishlist"]Steam[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40723180/cb9ee20792a7ed653b756d244bf9ea20629d5968.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Keep yourself updated on [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i] 🧡[/b][/h3][p] [/p][h3]Follow us on our socials[/h3][p]Naturally, you must be eager to see more of it! Until our next big announcement, please make sure you follow our socials. There we will share news on [i]Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy[/i], but we also chit chat a lot about the other Plague Tale games! notes.title: Focus Entertainment меняет название — издателя A Plague Tale переименуют в PulluP Entertainment
notes.content: Французская компания Focus Entertainment решила сменить название. С 1 апреля новые игры издателя дилогии A Plague Tale, вестерна Evil West, российской Atomic Heart и грядущей Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden будут выходить по лейблом PulluP Entertainment. О реорганизации сообщили в пресс-релизе.

notes.content:
Amicia and Hugo's journey in A Plague Tale: Requiem is fraught with strife and defined by anguish. As the rat game's protagonist starts to crumble under the weight of a hostile world, her mental state unravels, twisting into a PTSD-driven spiral. PCGamesN caught up with Charlotte McBurney, the BAFTA-nominated voice actor for Amicia, on the ground at WASD to discuss how both she and her character evolved during Requiem.

notes.title: Watch A Plague Tale Requiem: Symphony!
notes.content:
[b]A Plague Tale: Requiem has been nominated in no less than five categories for The Game Awards 2022, including the coveted Game of the Year award! [/b]

We're thrilled by this exciting chance, which confirms the overwhelmingly positive reception of the game.

Part of the success undeniably goes to the game’s remarkable score, also nominated as Best Music for The Game Awards, composed by Olivier Derivière and featuring world-class performers. [b]They gave an exceptional concert for the occasion of the game’s release, now available to watch on YouTube to celebrate the successful first weeks and nominations for The Game Awards. [/b]

https://youtu.be/J6FTmuf-6mY
A Plague Tale: Requiem is an intense emotional journey, powerfully enriched by Olivier Derivière’s poignant compositions. Olivier Derivière is a passionate video games composer and an international star in the field, who won multiple awards and a nomination for the 2017 BAFTA. His degree of implication is rare among video games composers, putting the gameplay at the center of his considerations and even influencing the development through his input.

The outstanding performers who collaborated with Olivier Derivière on the score include Eric-Maria Couturier – a distinguished member of the Ensemble Intercontemporain – and the two-time Grammy Award-winning Estonian Philharmonic Chamber Choir, who lend spellbinding vocals to the compositions.

Get the OST: https://olivierderiviere.bandcamp.com/album/a-plague-tale-requiem 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182900/A_Plague_Tale_Requiem/

notes.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem reveals its Accolades Trailer
notes.content:
Following its launch last week, A Plague Tale: Requiem has already conquered the hearts of many and garnered critical praise, with reviews heralding “a well-written, breathtaking, powerful adventure” as well as “one of the finest adventures around”.

[h3]Discover it all in today’s Accolades Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=zoEwC2TxiMA;full][/previewyoutube]
Highly focused on narration, A Plague Tale: Requiem supports [b]powerful emotions[/b] with [b]brilliant technical expertise[/b], in-depth [b]historical research[/b] and an immense attention to[b] the depiction of human traits[/b]. Altogether, the critics noted the game’s "incredible acting, storytelling, and characters" and praised its "awesome story, fantastic graphics".

We're absolutely thrilled by such a vibrant and positive reception, and can’t wait to hear all the thoughts and feelings you will share in the future as you journey through darkness with Amicia and Hugo.

A Plague Tale: Requiem is a heartrending tale, as one critic put it, “a story that will live on in my mind for years”. [b]And we're so proud about it.[/b]

Thank you all so much for the love and support you continuously send our way. It means so, so much. 🤎

notes.title: Одна из самых ярких игр года: Обзор A Plague Tale: Requem
notes.content: Три года потребовалось Asobo Studio, чтобы подготовить вполне ожидаемое продолжение своей истории о чуме, маленьком мальчике и его смелой сестре. Используя опыт оригинала, авторы проекта переносят нас во времени через несколько месяцев после окончания первой части игры. Амиция де Рун, ее брат Гуго, их мать и молодой алхимик Лука беззаботно проводят время вдалеке от разоренных городов и побежденной эпидемии. Зеленые луга, прозрачные ручьи и заброшенные замки будоражат их юное воображение, подталкивая к авантюрным поступкам. И именно один из них вновь оживляет дремлющую внутри Гуго скверну — Макулу. Так новое место постепенно превращается из милого провинциального рая в адский кошмар. Теперь Амиция и Лука при поддержке магистра тайного ордена пытаются остановить разрастающуюся эпидемию…

notes.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem is OUT!
notes.content:
[h3]A Plague Tale: Requiem, the direct sequel to the critically acclaimed and award-winning A Plague Tale: Innocence, has finally arrived.[/h3]

[h3]Far across the sea, an island calls…[/h3]

The heartrending story of Amicia and Hugo De Rune continues. Embark on their next journey and venture south of 14th century France before setting sail to a mysterious island out in the Mediterranean Sea. [b]Brave a terrible fate, looking for the cure to heal Hugo’s illness, and discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival within a dark, plague-ridden medieval world twisted by otherworldly forces[/b].

This new chapter stays true to the series’ defining sense of history and strong narrative direction and expands gameplay possibilities, granting extra freedom to players within a more open environment. [b]Choose to strike from the shadow or to unleash hell[/b], turning to Amicia’s new resources—including the use of alchemy to manipulate fire and the long-distance power of a crossbow, but also her cunning use of terrain and ability to wrestle out of an enemy’s grasp.

Designed for long-time fans and newcomers alike, A Plague Tale: Requiem brings a whole new level of realism, delivering [b]a sublime visual experience[/b] through the bright new Mediterranean setting and the characteristic contrast between light and dark of the series.

[b][url=https://youtu.be/EqHQCa4ciEI]CORSAIR's iCUE technology[/url] will make you experience an even more intense immersion[/b], reacting to the in-game action on your screen and synchronizing the RGB lighting on all your compatible CORSAIR devices for a setup-wide light show beyond compare.

notes.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem review
notes.content: Never work with children or animals, the old showbiz adage goes. And while the sentiment doesn't usually stretch to games, it's a brave developer who would place an impulsive five-year-old at the centre of a harrowing action adventure, or try to construct logical systems atop a horde of ravenous rats. Yet Asobo Studio managed exactly that with A Plague Tale: Innocence, and its bold sequel raises the stakes with an even defter touch... Read more.

notes.title: A Plague Tale is getting a sequel next year
notes.content:
Fans of rat-themed stealth-action rejoice! Developer Adobo's enormously enjoyable A Plague Tale is getting a sequel and it's coming to Xbox and PC some time next year.

Picking up after the events of the first game, A Plague Tale: Requiem, as the sequel is known, will follow Amicia and her brother Hugo on a perilous new quest, "doing whatever it takes to survive a brutal, uncaring world."

That's pretty much all we're getting at the moment, but expect plenty more details as A Plague Tale: Requiem readies to launch on Xbox and PC - as well as Game Pass - some time next year.
